name: @intent-wallet/scale
description: Global Scale & Resilience engine — the deterministic decision core that lets the platform grow from 1k to 100M+ users without a redesign. A bounded horizontal AUTOSCALER (metrics → desired replicas, clamped + anti-flap), a resilience toolkit (token-bucket rate limiter, concurrency bulkhead, generic circuit breaker, backoff+retry classifier, priority load-shedder), a multi-region ROUTER (active-active weighted / active-passive failover) and a CACHE-INVALIDATION engine. It DECIDES; an injected actuator ACTS — the engine never scales, drops, or reroutes anything itself, and every decision is bounded so a bug can't cause a scale-storm or a brown-out.
